remarks: Owners say, "It's time to Sell!"  Offered here is approximately 14-acres of scenic, hardwooded recreational land, which is nestled in the rolling hills of Portville New York. This site truly offers a private setting, with an excellent opportunity for your next new build: perhaps a hunting camp, a weekend retreat, or even a future getaway camping site.  A rustic handy-man's 760sq/ft cabin is part of the sale, and it's in "as is" condition, which gives you a head start for your new vision here. Loop Hollow is mainly a seasonal road, with many homes just down the road. You and your guests will be surrounded by abundant wildlife and beautiful quiet countryside. This property is conveniently located near Allegany State Park, and the Allegany National Forest Region, both of which have plenty of hiking trails. Adjacent to this parcel, snowmobile trails run from Portville, to Ellicottville, to East Otto. Whether you are looking to hunt, camp, or unwind in nature, this property offers outstanding value and potential. Some utilities do exist on site, and owner financing is available with a good credit score and a future plan for the land.
